items.title: Install State-Directed Engineering (SDE) v1.1.1 methodology inputs
items.description: Run npx @echelon-foundry/sde init to add the .sde/ methodology tree (18 managed files) alongside the ROS install.

items.title: Convert Strata design notebook into ROS requirements, decisions, experiments and work items
items.description: Phases 2-9: classify the pre-requirements notebook, challenge it, define minimum architecture and vertical slices, and publish ROS records plus backlog work items with traceability.

items.title: S1: Strata four-tier F# solution skeleton with mechanical architecture check
items.description: Create Strata.Semantic (netstandard2.0, FSharp.Core only), Strata.Analysis, Strata.Application, Strata.Host.Postgres, Strata.Host.PgParser, Strata.Cli and test projects. Add scripts/check-semantic-architecture.sh enforcing that Tier 1 references only FSharp.Core. Traces DF-STRATA-2026-D3F8, NFR-005.

items.title: S1: canonical semantic model for PostgreSQL schema objects
items.description: Tier 1 types for schemas, tables, columns, types, keys, constraints, indexes, views, routines, plus identity, provenance/evidence, categorical certainty, resolution state, managed-vs-observed scope and analysis completeness. Deliberately small per ER-014. Traces PR-006, PR-011, PR-014, PR-021, ER-008.

items.title: S1: PostgreSQL catalog introspection adapter
items.description: Tier 4 Npgsql adapter reading pg_catalog/information_schema into the canonical model, reporting per-category completeness including inaccessible metadata. Read-only, least privilege. Traces PR-004, PR-005, NFR-006, RK-004.

items.title: S1: deterministic semantic snapshot serialization
items.description: Deterministic, content-addressable JSON rendering of the semantic model with an explicit hand-written wire contract per Boundary Preservation. Traces PR-007, NFR-001, NFR-003, NFR-010.

items.title: S2: PostgreSQL parser adapter over pgsqlparser
items.description: Tier 4 adapter exposing a narrow DialectParser boundary (Parse, SplitStatements, Normalize, ParseRoutineBody, GetParserVersion, GetDialectVersion). Protobuf AST must not cross into Tier 1 or 2. Traces PR-001, PR-002, PR-003, DF-STRATA-2026-4C7A, ER-014.

items.title: S2: lexical scope resolution over the parse tree
items.description: Resolve CTE names, subquery aliases and table aliases into a scope chain before any reference becomes a dependency edge. Must not attribute a CTE-shadowed name to a real table. Traces PR-010, DF-STRATA-2026-9B2E, RK-001.

items.title: S2: reference extraction with explicit resolution states
items.description: Extract object and column references, classify each as resolved, partially-resolved, ambiguous, unsupported or unresolved; never collapse states. SELECT * must expand against a catalog snapshot or mark column analysis incomplete. Traces PR-009, PR-011, ER-008, RK-002.

items.title: S2: effect classification by consequence
items.description: Classify statements as read/insert/update/delete/merge/DDL/truncate/lock/routine-execution/dynamic/privilege/transaction-control/maintenance, capturing boundedness and data-loss possibility rather than statement type alone. Traces PR-015, ER-004.

items.title: S2: SQL corpus indexing with provenance
items.description: Index SQL units with source identifier, location, statement boundaries, content hash, dialect, parser version, parse status and extraction status. Traces PR-008, PR-014, NFR-002.

items.title: S3: dependency and relationship graph with evidence
items.description: Build declared edges from the catalog and observed edges from corpus join patterns, each carrying evidence count, sources and categorical certainty. Observed edges never become declared FKs. Traces PR-012, PR-013, ER-018, RK-017, HY-STRATA-2026-3C81.

items.title: S3: targeted retrieval queries and CLI output
items.description: Answer inspect/relationships/path/dependencies/readers/writers questions returning compact semantic slices with provenance and analysis scope, in JSON and human-readable form. Traces PR-016, PR-017, PR-021, ER-017, NG-010.

items.title: Spike B remainder: live-server binding comparison
items.description: Compare offline resolution against a live PostgreSQL server for search_path, overloaded functions, casts, operators, quoted identifiers, temp objects and ambiguous columns. Requires a PostgreSQL server, which was unavailable in the originating session. Resolves Q-005, Q-006, Q-027. Tests HY-STRATA-2026-4D92 and HY-STRATA-2026-5E03.

items.title: Record engineering metrics and SDE routing artefacts for the first Strata increment
items.description: SDE-MAP.md, feature manifests, and the engineering metrics record for WI-0003/0004/0007/0008.

items.title: Record final metrics and routing artefacts for slices S1-S3
items.description: Metrics record, SDE map and Tier 3 manifest for the completed work items.

items.title: S2/S3: index a SQL corpus from disk and build observed relationships from real data
items.description: Walk a directory of .sql files, parse and resolve each statement, index it with provenance, and derive read/write dependencies plus observed join relationships. Turns Corpus and Graph.observedFrom from unit-tested-in-principle into exercised on real data. Traces PR-008, PR-009, PR-012, PR-013, PR-016, HY-STRATA-2026-3C81.

items.title: Report unsupported join shapes as explicit analysis gaps
items.description: Join detection is equality-only. A corpus using BETWEEN, IN (SELECT ...) or range joins yields fewer relationships with no indication anything was missed, so 'no relationship found' and 'I do not analyse that shape' are the same output. Violates ER-008. Traces RK-007, PR-011.

items.title: Surface parser/server dialect divergence as a first-class analysis state
items.description: EV-STRATA-2026-C5D2 demonstrated the 17.5 parser accepting JSON_TABLE and MERGE...RETURNING which a 16.15 server rejects. Strata currently reports such a statement as cleanly parsed. Make the divergence part of the analysis scope so every answer carries it. Traces RK-003, NFR-004, Q-026.

items.title: Spike D: measure agent context cost of Strata retrieval versus raw corpus
items.description: Run EX-STRATA-2026-D4EA with its own measurement capture, since this runtime reports token metrics as unsupported to ROS telemetry. Tests HY-STRATA-2026-1E5D.

items.title: Reduce repeated scope overhead without weakening the safety property
items.description: EV-STRATA-2026-F4C6 measured the scope block at 1703B against a 485B answer, repeated verbatim per query. Emit it once per session with answers carrying a digest, while ALWAYS retaining the caveats that change how a result is read. Traces PR-021, NFR-003.

items.title: Evaluate whether targeted retrieval loses information the raw context has
items.description: Prerequisite for the agent-correctness experiment: if Strata's compact answer omits information needed to answer correctly, the token saving is worthless and NG-010's inverse risk is realised. Deterministic information-sufficiency comparison across a graded task set. Traces HY-STRATA-2026-2A6F, ER-017.

items.title: Spike D correctness half: run agents under both conditions
items.description: Six agents, three per condition, identical graded task set, only the context differs. Tests HY-STRATA-2026-2A6F.

items.title: Spike D-2: does Strata help with cross-module seam errors?
items.description: The previous correctness test asked lookup questions and hit a ceiling. Seam errors are consequence-across-a-boundary questions that no single file answers. Build a multi-module schema and corpus with planted seam defects, and test whether Strata's dependency graph helps agents find them. Tests HY-STRATA-2026-2A6F properly.

items.title: Column-level reader tracking: answer 'what breaks if I drop this column'
items.description: EV-STRATA-2026-B6F3 T1: Strata could not answer which files break when a column is dropped, because readers are tracked at table granularity only. CatalogResolution.columnDependencies already resolves column references per statement; they are simply not stored in the graph or exposed. Traces PR-012, PR-016, RK-002.

items.title: Spike D-3: seam correctness at a scale where reading everything is infeasible
items.description: Every prior result used a context an agent could read end to end. Build a corpus large enough that the raw context cannot fit in a prompt, make BOTH conditions interactive (tools, searching), and re-test the seam questions. Also a scale test of Strata's own indexing. Tests HY-STRATA-2026-2A6F and HY-STRATA-2026-1E5D at the crossover.

items.title: Correct the indexing-time figure in the scale evidence records
items.description: 247s was a cold-cache first run; warm is ~175s. Ratio against grep moves from 16,000x to 9,000-12,000x. Conclusions unchanged.

items.title: Spike D-4: messy corpus — unqualified names, shadowing, dynamic SQL, cross-schema collisions
items.description: EV-STRATA-2026-D7B2 showed grep wins on a uniformly schema-qualified corpus, which is grep's best case and a resolver's worst. Build the opposite: bare table names resolved by search_path, the same table name in three schemas, CTE shadowing, alias-obscured columns, comment-only mentions, SELECT *, and dynamic SQL. Decides whether the cached index and corpus-wide query are worth building. Tests HY-STRATA-2026-2A6F in the regime it was designed for.

items.title: Build a deterministic pre-deployment gate and test HY-STRATA-2026-6F14
items.description: Test whether deployment-safety value stands independently of agent leverage. Requires a gate: given proposed DDL, decide allow/block/needs-approval deterministically with evidence and a CI exit code, no agent in the loop. Then measure verdict correctness against a matrix of safe and dangerous changes, including false-positive rate (RK-016). Traces PR-018, PR-020, PR-024, NG-009.

items.title: Profile and fix indexing cost: single-pass extraction and hand-written gap formatting
items.description: Indexing was attributed to parser cost and the absence of a cache. Profiling shows 85% of analyse was sprintf "%A" building 58,578 gap-message strings per run that no code path reads, plus six redundant reflective walks of every parse tree. Replace %A with hand-written describe functions, collapse the six walks into one fold, default builds to Release, and record the measurement.

items.title: Qualified operator reported as both a join and an unmodelled shape
items.description: libpg_query reports an operator as a name path; OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) is [pg_catalog; =]. The join path scanned every element for = and recorded a join; the unmodelled path took the first element and reported a gap naming operator 'pg_catalog'. Both ran, so one node was reported two contradictory ways. Share one operator-symbol reader that takes the last element.

items.title: Record Q-003 decision: desired state is DACPAC-style object files
items.description: The desired-state authoring source was named: one declarative file per object, DACPAC/SSDT shape, with Strata diffing files against the live database. Records DF-STRATA-2026-B1E7 and the gap analysis it exposes.

items.title: Survey the declarative schema landscape and candidate fixtures
items.description: After DF-STRATA-2026-B1E7 fixed the product shape, survey what already does declarative PostgreSQL schema diffing, whether dependency-aware drop safety is novel, and which real repositories can serve as fixtures.

items.title: Slice V: validate candidate SQL against the schema (PR-018)
items.description: Validate a SQL file against a catalog snapshot. Every relation and column resolved; unresolved references reported as errors with position and exit code. The compile-time equivalent for agent-authored SQL. Tests HY-STRATA-2026-D5B8.

items.title: Slice P: strata.json project file and desired-state loader (PR-025)
items.description: Read a project manifest and per-object CREATE TABLE files into a SchemaSnapshot. Requires extracting ColumnDef name/type/nullability/default plus PK, FK, unique and check constraints, none of which the adapter reads today.

items.title: Slice D: diff desired against actual with dry-run output (PR-022, PR-023)
items.description: diff : desired -> actual -> Change list, fed to the existing DeploymentGate. Honours NG-006 and 1437: absence from desired state never implies delete, and objects outside managedSchemas are never dropped.

items.title: Slice X: execute a plan against the database (PR-024)
items.description: Ordered DDL from the Change list, gate as precondition, fingerprint check so a plan cannot apply to a database that changed after planning, verification after execution per ER-011.

items.title: Requirements and decisions for validation and deployment capabilities
items.description: Promote PR-018 to active and PR-022/023/024 out of deferred, add PR-025 for the project manifest, record DF-STRATA-2026-A4D9 (strata.json plus schema/<schema>/<type>/<name>.sql) and HY-STRATA-2026-D5B8 (validation catches what reasoning does not), and mark Q-003 answered.

items.title: Record PostgreSQL-only scope and the dialect port's known leaks
items.description: Other engines are phase two. Record that the port boundary already holds (no engine packages above Tier 4) and list the three places PostgreSQL has leaked past it, so phase two is a known quantity rather than a discovery.
